entity.summary: Non-custodial wallet ecosystem for Ronin and supported networks, distributed as browser-extension and mobile wallet surfaces.
entity.notes: Current first-party documentation establishes Ronin Wallet as a non-custodial wallet available as extension and mobile app. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Ronin Wallet browser extension for managing Ronin and supported assets from desktop browsers.
products.notes: The extension is modeled separately from Ronin Mobile because browser and mobile runtimes have distinct distribution and security lifecycles. Current first-party documentation supports Chrome, Edge and Firefox; initial extension launch date remains unresolved.

evidence.title: Ronin Wallet Overview
evidence.notes: First-party support article describes Ronin Wallet as non-custodial and available as desktop browser extension and mobile app.

evidence.title: Ronin Wallet Desktop Guide
evidence.notes: Current first-party desktop guide explicitly distributes Ronin Wallet Extension for Chrome, Edge and Firefox, supporting the separate browser-extension product boundary.
